pm_jan_dhan.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
pm_jan_dhan.description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion to ensure access to financial services like savings accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension.

pm_kisan.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
pm_kisan.description: Central Sector Scheme providing income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families.

atal_pension.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
atal_pension.description: Pension scheme for citizens of India focused on the unorganized sector workers.

sukanya_samriddhi.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
sukanya_samriddhi.description: Small savings scheme for a girl child launched under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign.

pm_mudra.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
pm_mudra.description: Scheme for providing loans up to Rs. 10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.

pmjjby.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
pmjjby.description: One-year life insurance scheme renewable from year to year offering life cover of Rs. 2 Lakhs.

pmsby.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
pmsby.description: One-year accidental insurance scheme renewable from year to year offering accidental death and disability cover of Rs. 2 Lakhs.
